title: Terms of Use
metaDescription: The rules for using the HudhudNest real-estate marketplace: accounts, listings, user conduct, our role as a platform, and your rights.

blocks.p: These Terms of Use ("Terms") are an agreement between you and the operator of the Platform, which trades as {{CONTROLLER_NAME}} ("we", "us"; see section 29 and the [Impressum](/impressum)), and govern your use of the website {{WEBSITE}} and the apps (the "Platform").

You accept these Terms when you create an account by ticking the acceptance box, or when you sign in with Google or Apple and confirm the notice shown to you. Visitors without an account may browse public listings; the rules in these Terms that apply to visitors (such as sections 8, 18 and 19) apply to that use. Our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy) explains how we process personal data; it is information, not a contract, and acknowledging it is not consent to any processing.
The newsletter is separate from these Terms: accepting these Terms never subscribes you to marketing, and you can use every feature without subscribing.

sections.heading: What HudhudNest is, and what it is not

blocks.p: HudhudNest is an online platform that lets users publish and discover property listings (sale, long-term rent, short stays and investment projects) and contact one another. Users, not HudhudNest, create listings and decide whether and on what terms to deal with each other.

ul: We are not a party to any sale, rental, booking or other agreement between users, and we do not act as a real-estate broker, agent, landlord, lawyer or financial adviser for any user.

We do not own, manage or inspect the properties advertised, and unless a listing is expressly marked by us as verified, we do not verify that an advertiser owns or is authorised to offer a property, or that the information in a listing is accurate or complete.
We do not guarantee that any listing will lead to a transaction, or that any user will act honestly, lawfully or as promised.

blocks.p: You must be at least 18 years old and have the legal capacity to enter into a binding agreement to use the Platform. If you register on behalf of an agency or other organisation, you confirm that you are authorised to bind it. You may not use the Platform if you have been suspended or removed from it, or if the law prohibits you from doing so.

ul: Provide accurate, current information when registering and keep it up to date.
Keep your credentials and any verification codes confidential. You are responsible for activity under your account unless you notify us promptly of unauthorised use at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}.
One person should not hold multiple accounts to evade a suspension or a limit.
We may require phone or email verification, and may ask you to re-verify periodically, to protect the Platform.

blocks.p: You are responsible for your conduct on the Platform and for complying with the laws that apply to you and to the property you advertise, including property, rental, consumer, tax, licensing, anti-discrimination and data-protection rules. Before entering any transaction you should independently verify the property, the other party's identity and authority, ownership documents, prices, fees and legal status, and, where appropriate, obtain professional advice. Do not transfer money or sensitive documents before you are satisfied that the other party is genuine.

ul: A listing must describe a real property or project that you are entitled to advertise, accurately and without misleading omissions (type, location, size, price, availability, condition, fees, legal status).
Prices and terms must reflect what you are actually offering. Update or remove a listing promptly when it is no longer available.
Listings are public. Do not include personal data or contact details you do not want published.
We may limit the number, type or visibility of listings, require review of certain accounts, and display listings in the order and manner we choose.

blocks.p: By publishing a listing you declare that you are the owner of the property or are duly authorised by the owner to advertise it, and that, where you act as an agent or agency, you hold any licence or authorisation required by the law that applies to you. If you are an agent, you must make that capacity clear.
You must not:

ul: publish listings that are fake, duplicated to mislead, unavailable, bait-and-switch, or for property you have no right to offer;
post unlawful, discriminatory, hateful, harassing, defamatory, obscene or infringing content;
upload photos or text you do not have the right to use, or images that misrepresent the property;
collect or scrape other users' data, send spam, or use the Platform to solicit unrelated goods or services;
attempt to bypass security, rate limits or access controls, interfere with the Platform, or probe it for vulnerabilities without our written permission;
impersonate another person or organisation, or misstate your affiliation;
use the Platform for money laundering, fraud or any unlawful purpose.

blocks.p: Fraud, deceptive practices and misrepresentation are grounds for immediate removal of content and suspension or termination of the account, and we may report suspected unlawful activity to the competent authorities and cooperate with their lawful requests. If you encounter suspicious listings or behaviour, report it to {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}.

sections.heading: User content and licence to us

blocks.p: You keep ownership of the content you submit (listings, text, photos, reviews, messages, profile). You are solely responsible for it and confirm that you have all rights needed to submit it.

You grant us a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence, for as long as the content is on the Platform and for a reasonable period afterwards, to host, store, reproduce, resize, adapt for format, display and distribute your content for the purposes of operating, securing, improving and promoting the Platform. This includes showing public listing content on the Platform and republishing it (for example a photo, headline, price and location) on HudhudNest's own channels on third-party social platforms to promote the listing. You can ask us to stop promoting a listing by removing it or contacting us.

Photos must show the advertised property or project and not mislead. Do not upload images showing identifiable people, ID documents or private information without the necessary permission. Image links are public. We may resize, compress or remove media, and may remove content that breaches these Terms.

The Platform lets users message each other and, in some cases, request visits or bookings. You are responsible for what you send and for your dealings with other users, whether on or off the Platform. Be respectful and do not use messaging for spam, harassment or fraud. We may review messages where needed to investigate abuse or a breach of these Terms, as described in the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Marketplace disclaimer and no guarantee of transactions

blocks.p: Dealings between users are solely their own. To the extent permitted by applicable law, we are not responsible for the conduct of users, for the quality, safety, legality or availability of any property, or for whether a transaction takes place or is completed as agreed. Reviews and ratings are opinions of users, not statements by us.

Information on the Platform, including prices, areas, descriptions, maps, location data and any valuation or investment information, is provided by users or third parties and for general information only. Map positions may be approximate. A valuation received through the Platform is an opinion of the office that provided it, not a binding appraisal by us. Investment project information is not an offer of securities and is not financial, legal or tax advice; you should do your own due diligence.

Where the Platform supports short-stay booking requests, a booking is an arrangement between the guest and the host. We provide the technical means to request, confirm and manage it. Unless the Platform expressly states otherwise, payment, deposits, house rules, cancellation and refunds are agreed between guest and host and handled outside the Platform. Hosts are responsible for lawful operation of their accommodation (including any registration, licensing or tax requirements).

Basic use of the Platform may be free, and some features (such as higher listing limits, featured placement or agency plans) may depend on a plan. Where a fee applies, the price, billing period, renewal and cancellation terms will be shown to you before you commit. Where a refund or cancellation right is granted by mandatory law, it applies regardless of this section. The Platform does not currently collect payment-card details itself; if that changes, these Terms will be updated first.

Ranking: search results and lists are ordered by your filters and by listing attributes such as how recent a listing is. Paid featured listings, and the paid listings of the area you chose, are shown first and are marked as featured. We do not accept payment to change the order in any other way.

The Platform uses third-party services (for example sign-in, maps, image hosting, email and messaging providers) and may link to external sites. We do not control them and are not responsible for their content, availability or practices; your use of them may be subject to their own terms.
